use_cases: Displaying content in an elegant frosted glass card with customizable blur and shadow effects
Creating interactive draggable card interfaces with smooth motion animations
Building expandable card components that reveal additional content on click
Designing premium-feeling UI elements with backdrop blur and glass effects
Implementing configurable card layouts with responsive sizing options
ai_summary: A highly configurable liquid glass card component featuring frosted glass aesthetics with backdrop blur effects, inset shadows, and glow capabilities. Supports drag-and-drop interactions, expandable states, and smooth animations via motion/react. Ideal for creating premium card-based interfaces with glass-morphism styling in SaaS, e-commerce, and media applications.
